title: Ridge preservation using Collacone compared with an empty socket: a pilot study
authors: Anderud J, Lennholm C, Wälivaara DÅOral Surg Oral Med Oral Pathol Oral Radiol. 2021 Aug;132(2):e55-e61. doi: 10.1016/j.oooo.2021.01.012. * collacone®
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The use of a Collacone collagen sponge does not enhance the bone and soft tissue healing outcome after extraction of an incisor in the maxilla compared with leaving the alveolus empty” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
